findings.title: Ticket key in commit subjects
findings.problem: All six commit subjects carry EPMCDME-16958. git-workflow.md anti-pattern: when scope already conveys context, reference the ticket in the body footer.
findings.impact: Subject lines become permanent history; commit-format is a blocking standard in this gate.
findings.recommendation: Reword each subject to <type>(<scope>): <subject> without the key and move EPMCDME-16958 into a body footer.
findings.check_notes: Subjects at HEAD 316912eb still carry EPMCDME-16958; the fix-up changes no commit and no source path.

findings.title: Failed headless login exits 0
findings.problem: handleLogin failure branch (lines 111-115) prints the error and returns without setting process.exitCode, so a failed profile login --no-browser exits 0.
findings.impact: Scripts and CI treat a failed paste-back login as success. The branch is shared with browser login, so the gap predates the flag but is newly reachable from headless automation.
findings.recommendation: Set process.exitCode = 1 in the failure branch and cover the exit code in a test.
findings.check_notes: auth.ts sets process.exitCode = 1 in both failure branches (lines 115 and 121); exit-code test added in auth.test.ts.

fix.change: handleLogin failure branch and outer catch set process.exitCode = 1
fix.test: exits non-zero when a headless login fails (profile/__tests__/auth.test.ts)

findings.title: handlePluginSetup takes six positional parameters
findings.problem: handlePluginSetup has six positional parameters; code-quality guide caps at 4-5 and asks for destructuring when there are several.
findings.impact: Blocking code-quality standard; each new flag extends the positional list.
findings.recommendation: Pass storageLocation and headless through one destructured options object parameter.
findings.check_notes: handlePluginSetup takes four positional params plus one destructured options object (setup.ts:243-248).

fix.change: handlePluginSetup takes storageLocation and headless as one destructured options object

findings.title: setup --no-browser wiring has no test
findings.problem: The flag-to-getCredentials wiring (setup.ts lines 235 and 255) is covered by no test. Existing headless tests call getCredentials directly, so dropping the flag would leave tests green.
findings.impact: codemie setup --no-browser could silently run the browser SSO path with no test failing.
findings.recommendation: Add a test running the setup command with --no-browser asserting authenticate receives headless true, plus a no-flag case asserting it does not.
findings.check_notes: setup-headless.test.ts asserts headless true for --no-browser and --headless and false without the flag. The file is untracked and not in changed_files; it must be committed with the fix.

fix.change: added setup --no-browser / --headless wiring tests through createSetupCommand
fix.test: asks the SSO credential step to run headless with --no-browser (cli/commands/__tests__/setup-headless.test.ts)

findings.title: claude auth login has no headless timeout message
findings.problem: Design requires claude auth login to fail with a clear timeout message. runClaudeBrowserLogin is unchanged (300000 ms), so expiry surfaces as the generic 'Command timed out after 300000ms'.
findings.impact: Required spec behaviour is partial. A headless user whose login times out gets no pointer to claude setup-token or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
findings.recommendation: In the headless path, catch the timeout and raise a ConfigurationError naming claude auth login, claude setup-token and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
findings.check_notes: runHeadlessClaudeLogin (setup-steps.ts:47-57) wraps any login failure, timeout included, in a message naming both routes. Fix sits in a changed file; the cited helper is unchanged.

fix.change: headless claude login runs through runHeadlessClaudeLogin, which maps any failure to a fixed message naming both routes
fix.test: names both routes when the headless login does not complete (anthropic-subscription.headless.test.ts)

findings.title: No-TTY error omits claude login routes
findings.problem: AC13 partial: the no-TTY ConfigurationError at line 47 names neither claude auth login nor claude setup-token / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Only the instruction block and final-status error name both.
findings.impact: Required message text is missing on a failure path; a user in a non-TTY shell gets no actionable route.
findings.recommendation: Name claude auth login and claude setup-token with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the no-TTY error and in the claude login failure path.
findings.check_notes: NO_TTY_CLAUDE_MESSAGE names claude auth login, claude setup-token and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; the login-failure message does too.

fix.change: no-TTY error names claude auth login, claude setup-token and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
fix.test: names both routes when the headless TTY check fails (anthropic-subscription.headless.test.ts)

findings.title: Browser callback wiring has no test
findings.problem: handleCallback (line 395, reached via line 308) now delegates to parseSSOToken. The only non-headless test stubs startLocalServer and waitForCallback, and nothing drives handleCallback with a real URL.
findings.impact: Default browser sign-in could fail or store wrong credentials and no test would fail.
findings.recommendation: Add a test driving the callback handler with a real ?token= URL and asserting success, apiUrl and cookies.
findings.check_notes: New browser-callback describe drives handleCallback with a ?token= URL; handleCallback (sso.auth.ts:395-405) delegates to parseSSOToken and the test asserts the exact success shape. Test-only fix; source unchanged and correct.

fix.change: none to source; browser callback path now covered by a direct handleCallback test
fix.test: resolves a ?token= callback URL into apiUrl and cookies (sso/__tests__/sso.auth.test.ts)

findings.title: promptForPastedToken exceeds 50-line limit
findings.problem: promptForPastedToken spans lines 23-81 (59 lines), over the code-quality 50-line rule. getCredentials in anthropic-subscription.setup-steps.ts also grew to about 80 lines.
findings.impact: Blocking code-quality standard.
findings.recommendation: Split into module-private helpers (raw-mode setup, data handling, finish); move the headless TTY precheck and instruction printing out of getCredentials.
findings.check_notes: promptForPastedToken now spans 46 lines (sso.paste-prompt.ts:48-93). getCredentials (about 75 lines) is not the cited function and was already over 50 before this change.

fix.change: promptForPastedToken split into assertCanPrompt and applyKey helpers; body now under 50 lines
fix.test: n/a (behaviour unchanged; existing sso.paste-prompt tests pass)

findings.title: Scheme-less pasted redirect address rejected
findings.problem: extractRawToken only parses input starting with http(s):// or ?. An address such as localhost:port/?token=... is returned as a raw token, fails base64 JSON decode, and yields INVALID_TOKEN.
findings.impact: A copied redirect address without its scheme, the input the paste flow exists for, is rejected and consumes one of three attempts.
findings.recommendation: Treat input carrying token, auth or data query params as a URL even without a scheme, and add a test for localhost:port/?token=... input.
findings.check_notes: looksLikeRedirect (sso.token-parser.ts:39-42) treats token, auth or data query params as redirects; scheme-less input parses against a placeholder base; test added.

fix.change: extractRawToken treats scheme-less addresses carrying token/auth/data params as redirects
fix.test: accepts a scheme-less redirect address carrying a token param (sso.token-parser.test.ts)

findings.title: Exported parseSSOToken lacks JSDoc with @throws
findings.problem: parseSSOToken is exported and throws ConfigurationError but has no JSDoc with @throws. promptForPastedToken (sso.paste-prompt.ts:23) has the same gap.
findings.impact: Blocking code-quality standard for exported functions.
findings.recommendation: Add JSDoc blocks to both exports with a @throws ConfigurationError line listing the invalid-token, missing-cookies, no-TTY, timeout and abort cases.
findings.check_notes: JSDoc with @throws ConfigurationError added to promptForPastedToken (sso.paste-prompt.ts:41-47) and parseSSOToken (sso.token-parser.ts:78-84).

fix.change: JSDoc with @throws added to parseSSOToken and promptForPastedToken

findings.title: Analytics re-auth hint has no test
findings.problem: The codemie profile login --no-browser hint at AgentCLI.ts lines 389-390 is covered by no test. No test references the 'Re-authenticate later' or 'analytics authentication is invalid' strings.
findings.impact: Removing the hint would go unnoticed. This is user guidance only, with no behaviour consequence today.
findings.recommendation: Add a test asserting the output contains the codemie profile login --no-browser --url line for the configured codeMieUrl.

findings.title: No-TTY text duplicated from NO_TTY_MESSAGE
findings.problem: The no-TTY text is a literal here and NO_TTY_MESSAGE in sso.paste-prompt.ts line 19. The two copies can drift, and the anthropic test asserts on a regex.
findings.impact: No behaviour today; drift risk only.
findings.recommendation: Share one constant or reference the shared message.

findings.title: Abort branch matches the wrong error
findings.problem: The catch checks name === 'AbortError' or message === 'AbortError'. promptForPastedToken rejects with ConfigurationError(ABORT_MESSAGE), so the branch never matches. The generic path returns the same text. The test mocks a rejection named AbortError, so it passes.
findings.impact: No user-visible effect today because the returned text is identical. The test does not exercise the real error.
findings.recommendation: Match ConfigurationError with ABORT_MESSAGE explicitly, drop the message === 'AbortError' comparison, and make the test reject with the real error.

findings.title: Headless output ignores the quiet flag
findings.problem: authenticateHeadless prints the URL and instructions via console.log unconditionally. types.ts (SSOAuthConfig.quiet) documents quiet as suppressing stdout for callers whose stdout contract forbids extra output.
findings.impact: No production caller combines quiet with headless today. A future hook caller doing so would corrupt its stdout.
findings.recommendation: Route the headless prints through the quiet guard, or reject quiet with headless explicitly, and document the choice.

findings.title: Headless VITE_API_URL override lacks store-level test
findings.problem: Headless success returns parsed.apiUrl. The headless store test stubs fetch as ok:false and never reads the stored apiUrl. The override is covered only at parser level.
findings.impact: A wrong stored API base on the headless path would not be caught.
findings.recommendation: Add an authenticate test with fetch returning VITE_API_URL and assert storeSSOCredentials receives that apiUrl.

findings.title: Browser callback error text changed without note
findings.problem: handleCallback now returns INVALID_TOKEN / MISSING_COOKIES instead of the original 'Missing token parameter in OAuth callback' and 'Token missing cookies field'. No src caller or test matches the old text.
findings.impact: AC15 says the non-flag path behaves as today; the wording change is undocumented.
findings.recommendation: Note the wording change in the change description, or keep the old strings on the callback path.

findings.title: Arrow-key escape text appended to pasted token
findings.problem: onData keeps every character at or above space. ESC is dropped, but '[' and the final letter of an arrow sequence are appended, so the buffer gains '[A'. The regex the edge lens suggested is not in the code.
findings.impact: A token with an arrow key pressed during paste is rejected, consuming one of three attempts.
findings.recommendation: Strip CSI (ESC [ ... final byte) and ESC O sequences before appending.

findings.title: Paste buffer has no size cap
findings.problem: The buffer grows without limit until a newline arrives or the 120 s deadline fires.
findings.impact: Only large user-generated pastes; negligible in practice.
findings.recommendation: Cap the buffer length and reject oversize input with a fixed message.

findings.title: Raw-mode failure leaks timer and abort listener
findings.problem: The timer (line 69) and abort listener (line 73) are registered before setRawMode (line 76) runs inside the executor. If it throws, the promise rejects with a raw Error while the timer stays alive until the deadline and the listener stays attached.
findings.impact: Rare: setRawMode throws only on unusual streams. The process stays alive up to the deadline and the error text is not the fixed message.
findings.recommendation: Move setRawMode and setEncoding ahead of timer and listener registration, or wrap them in try and map failures to NO_TTY_MESSAGE.

findings.title: stdin encoding changed and never restored
findings.problem: setEncoding('utf8') at line 77 is never restored, and finish() calls stdin.pause() unconditionally (line 46) even when the caller had stdin flowing.
findings.impact: Later readers in the same process inherit utf8 string mode and paused state. Narrow, and it depends on what runs after the login.
findings.recommendation: Save and restore the previous encoding, and pause only when stdin was not already flowing.

findings.title: promptForReauth headless branch has no caller
findings.problem: promptForReauth(config, headless) is called only with one argument (auth-validation.ts:35). The headless branch is reached only from tests (sso.setup-steps.test.ts lines 121-128).
findings.impact: Dead parameter with no behaviour today; misleading for future maintainers.
findings.recommendation: Remove the parameter, or wire a production caller that passes headless and cover it.

findings.title: Malformed cookies accepted as valid
findings.problem: decodeToken accepts an empty cookies object and non-string values. Line 66 casts without checking, so a non-string value is stringified as [object Object] in the cookie header (line 87).
findings.impact: A malformed pasted token is stored as valid credentials and fails later. The browser path shares this decoder.
findings.recommendation: Require a non-empty object whose values are strings; otherwise throw MISSING_COOKIES.

findings.title: AbortSignal.any unavailable on early Node 20
findings.problem: AbortSignal.any (line 84) is not defined on early Node 20 releases (my understanding: added in 20.3). engines declares >=20.0.0 (package.json lines 186-187). The TypeError is swallowed by the catch at line 97, so VITE_API_URL is silently ignored.
findings.impact: Only on Node 20.0-20.2; headless login succeeds against the default API base with no error.
findings.recommendation: Guard with typeof AbortSignal.any === 'function', or raise the engines floor to 20.3, and add a test for the no-override fallback.

findings.title: Ctrl+C during config.js fetch still stores credentials
findings.problem: The catch at line 97 swallows the abort from opts.signal, so parseSSOToken returns success with the default apiUrl and authenticate stores credentials after the user cancelled.
findings.impact: Narrow window, only while the config.js fetch (up to 5 s) is in flight; credentials are stored after a cancel message.
findings.recommendation: Rethrow ConfigurationError with ABORT_MESSAGE when opts.signal is aborted, before the fallback.

standards_review.notes: Six subjects are valid type(scope) but each carries EPMCDME-16958; guide says reference the ticket in the body footer (CR-001).
promptForPastedToken is 59 lines (limit 50); handlePluginSetup has 6 params; new exports lack JSDoc @throws (CR-003, CR-008, CR-010).
No logging of pasted input or cookies; fixed error strings; credentials stored via CredentialStore.

final_round.rationale: Ten blocking findings: two critical spec gaps (claude login timeout message, no-TTY route guidance), a headless login failure that exits 0, a scheme-less pasted redirect address rejected, untested browser-callback and setup-flag wiring, and four standards blockers (commit subjects, function length, parameter count, JSDoc). All four lenses and standards ran with parseable output, nothing was truncated, and the spec was present so acceptance was not skipped. Zero deferred; 14 advisory; 11 dismissed (see code-review-dismissed.local.md); no reachability gap, oversized diff or standards coverage gap.
